_doc: Curated registry of open-source IP-core CODENAMES. Used by backlog_sanitize_check.py as a SOFT (WARN) deny-list, keyed ONLY on a backlog submission's generic-description title field. These names are legitimate everywhere else (ip_catalog_* programs reuse OSS IP; backlog session_context / pattern / suggested_fix legitimately record what design was run or list a corpus). The guard exists only so a backlog's one-line generic GAP description stays IC-class-generic (describe 'a bit-serial RISC-V core', not 'serv'). This is a maintained DATA file, NOT a regex literal baked into the detector (general-not-keyword doctrine). Matching is whole-word, case-insensitive.
